inputs.text: South Dakota is right to make citizenship a basic requirement for voting in its own state elections. Senate Bill 175 is a measured safeguard, applying only to new registrants and state elections. A nation’s self-government depends on clear rules and public confidence in the ballot; the future of South Dakota should be decided by its citizens.
